rationale: Roberts is best positioned to hold an 8-1 coalition together with a narrow, administrable remedy: refund only the unconstitutional differential, emphasizing unlawful-exaction principles and that “equalizing up” would require new statutory authorization. Alito is likely to dissent on Landgraf/separation-of-powers and fiscal-disruption grounds, while Thomas or Gorsuch may add a concurrence grounding the remedy more explicitly in historical unlawful-exaction doctrine.
